diffs.diff: minimum supply: part 4.5 V, datasheet reading 5 V
diffs.evidence: SRD-05VDC-SL-C datasheet, section 6 COIL DATA CHART, SRD (High Sensitivity, L=0.36W) code 05: Nominal Voltage 05 VDC, Nominal Current 71.4 mA, Coil Resistance 70 ohm, Pull-In Voltage '75% Max.' (= 3.75 V), Max-Allowable Voltage '120%' (= 6.0 V). 5 V is only the nominal coil voltage, not the minimum; the relay is guaranteed to pull in at 3.75 V, so the model's 4.5 V minimum (nominal -10%) is a conservative value inside the datasheet window. The second reading copied the nominal 5 V into both vmin and vmax. Its own second source (components101 dual-channel relay module) also states 'Supply voltage - 3.75V to 6V'.

diffs.diff: maximum supply: part 5.5 V, datasheet reading 5 V
diffs.evidence: SRD-05VDC-SL-C datasheet, section 6 COIL DATA CHART: High Sensitivity (SL) series Max-Allowable Voltage '120%' of the 5 VDC nominal = 6.0 V (Standard series is 110% = 5.5 V). The model's 5.5 V maximum (nominal +10%) is at or below the allowable coil voltage for either sensitivity grade, so it is safe; 5 V is the nominal rating, not a maximum. components101 dual-channel relay module page: 'Supply voltage - 3.75V to 6V'.
